intent: Continue the user-requested historical over-tightness audit across researcher presentation, model-memory admission, verification/search stopping rules, agent authority and orchestration. Preserve no-lookahead, Evidence truthfulness, claim-scoped authority, source-independence, temporal precision, sealed-memory provenance and explicit Reality/Judgment/Outcome separation. Relax rules that incorrectly turn an incomplete research plan into loss of a useful research lead, or turn anti-premature-stop search-depth defaults into document/query quotas after authoritative claim-scoped content already resolves the question. Keep strict readiness checks at the actual delegated-search/exhausted-unresolved boundary rather than at Memory Lead preservation.
rationale_summary: The audit found a concrete CAP-0006 contradiction: fragmentary Memory Leads are supposed to be preserved, but typed Atlas admission currently requires complete positive and disconfirmation query/source plans. It also found that verification depth is enforced as an unconditional stop gate even when claim-scoped authoritative content already resolves a claim. Reuse CAP-0006 for lead preservation and post-seal verification, CAP-0007 for execution readiness, CAP-0005 for researcher visibility, and CAP-0010 for scoped governance; create no new semantic owner.
